item.title: Amazon Quick resource migration automated with Bedrock AgentCore MCP server
item.description:
Amazon Quick resource migration automated with Bedrock AgentCore MCP server

Amazon Quick is Amazon’s agentic AI companion built for work. Moving its resources – chat agents, action connectors, knowledge bases, flows, and spaces – from a development AWS account to a production account has traditionally been a manual, error‑prone chore.

🔍 Overview

  • Enterprises often run separate AWS accounts for development, QA, and production.
  • There is no native one‑click way to promote validated Quick resources into the next account; teams must rebuild each resource by hand.
  • The Quick Resource Migrator is a sample Model Context Protocol (MCP) server hosted on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that automates this cross‑account promotion with a single tool call.

🛠️ How it works

  • The migrator composes the Create, Read, Update, and List API calls of the Amazon Quick API into a repeatable workflow; it never issues a delete, so a run only adds or updates.
  • It is resource‑driven – you pick a resource type (agent, connector, knowledge base, flow, or space) and select resources by ID, name, or all.
  • The server runs on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime and can be triggered from Amazon Quick or any MCP‑compatible client.
Resource Type Migration actions
Chat agents Recreate with custom instructions, identity, tone, starter prompts, welcome message; re‑attach action connectors (remapped to target).
Action connectors Recreate configuration; secret values never read – placeholders are created then re‑authenticated in target.
Knowledge bases Register in target, recreate data source, copy permissions; for S3‑backed bases also provision target bucket and bucket policy (documents are not copied).
Flows Recreate from definition; matched by name – same‑named flow is updated, otherwise a new flow is created.
Spaces Recreate in target and re‑link to agents, connectors, and knowledge bases with ARN remapping; agents are automatically re‑linked when a space migrates.

⚙️ Key features

  • Idempotent – safe to re‑run; performs upserts (creates missing resources, updates existing ones).
  • Permission fidelity – calls Describe*Permissions on the source and replays identical actions in the target, remapping ARNs.
  • Versioned backup – every update is preceded by a backup written to Amazon S3, giving a full history for review or rollback.
  • Read‑only preview – reports exactly what would be created or updated before committing.
  • Single‑call promotion – a chosen set of resources is promoted in one operation.
  • Programmable – all resources are managed through the Amazon Quick API (full CRUDL lifecycle).
  • Open source – full source code is available in the aws-samples repository.

🚀 Availability

  • The MCP server is hosted on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime.
  • It can be invoked from Amazon Quick or any client that supports MCP.
  • Source code and deployment instructions are published in the public aws-samples GitHub repository.

💡 Why it matters

  • Enterprises with separate development and production AWS accounts can eliminate a manual, error‑prone promotion process.
  • Consistent permission copying and versioned backups reduce risk of misconfiguration in production.
  • Idempotent upserts and preview mode enable safe, repeatable migrations, supporting CI/CD pipelines and governance.
  • By automating promotion, teams can focus on building and evaluating agentic AI solutions rather than on repetitive infrastructure work.

#AmazonQuick #Bedrock #MCP #AIautomation

Source: Making Amazon Quick enterprise-ready: Automated, auditable cross-account resource promotion | Amazon Web Services Source: Evaluating multi-agent systems for explainability and helpfulness with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services

item.title: Wiz Hires Support Engineer with AI-Driven Automation Focus
item.description:
Wiz Hires Support Engineer with AI-Driven Automation Focus

Wiz, a cloud security company, published a job advertisement for a Remote Solutions Support Engineer based in Ireland, indicating a new role that combines deep technical troubleshooting with a growing emphasis on AI-driven automation to scale support operations.

🔍 Role Overview

The Remote Solutions Support Engineer will be part of a global team delivering expert-level technical support across the Wiz cloud-native security platform. The role involves investigating complex, multi-domain issues spanning cloud infrastructure, workload protection, vulnerability management, and runtime defense across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.

⚙️ Key Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant customer-facing technical experience.
  • 2+ years working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) including IAM, networking, and core compute/storage services.
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience deploying, managing, and troubleshooting production Kubernetes clusters and containerized applications.
  • Experience reading and debugging code in Python, Shell, JavaScript/JSON, Java, Go, or Terraform/HCL.
  • Proficiency with command-line tools and Linux operating system environments.
  • Familiarity with the current AI landscape, including LLM architectures and the integration of AI-driven tooling into technical workflows.

💡 Why It Matters

Wiz states it is redefining security for the AI era and is “powered by Google,” offering an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations. The job description emphasizes a growing emphasis on AI-driven automation to scale support operations and improve resolution quality, with preferred qualifications including experience building or supporting agentic workflows, RAG architectures, or AI-powered automation.

🚀 Availability

Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role. The position includes an after-hours, holiday, and weekend on-call rotation.

#Wiz #CloudSecurity #AIAutomation #Kubernetes #SupportEngineer

Source: Remote Solutions Support Engineer at Wiz, Inc.

item.title: ConTech AI Shifts Toward Operational Workflow Automation
item.description:
ConTech AI Shifts Toward Operational Workflow Automation

AI adoption in construction technology is progressing beyond conversational interfaces to the automation of operational workflows. This shift is part of a broader new phase in the US AEC software market characterized by increased venture funding and strategic M&A activity.

⚙️ Key details

AI is shifting from chat interfaces into executing specific construction tasks. Capabilities now include the automation of:

  • Estimating
  • Preconstruction
  • Document review
  • RFIs
  • Field reporting
  • Scheduling

💡 Why it matters

This transition represents a move from tools that simply assist users to platforms focused on executing work. Procore’s positioning of AI-powered “digital coworkers” illustrates this focus on executing operational workflows rather than relying on conversational interfaces.

#ConTech #AEC #AIautomation #ConstructionTechnology

Source: Best of LinkedIn CW 34/ 35: Digital Construction

item.title: CrewAI introduces open-source multi-agent framework and AMP Suite
item.description:
CrewAI introduces open-source multi-agent framework and AMP Suite

CrewAI has launched an open-source Python framework for building production-ready multi-agent workflows, alongside the CrewAI AMP Suite for enterprise-grade deployment and management.

🔍 Overview

CrewAI is an open-source Python framework designed to enable autonomous agent collaboration through Crews and precise, event-driven control through Flows. It fosters collaborative intelligence, allowing agents to work together seamlessly on complex tasks.

🧩 How it works

  • Crews: Optimize for autonomy and collaborative intelligence with role-based AI agents.
  • Flows: Build event-driven automations combining precise workflow control, single LLM calls, and native support for Crews.
  • High-level abstractions and low-level APIs: Provides flexibility for developers to build production-ready multi-agent systems.

⚙️ Key details

CrewAI offers:

  • Role-based AI agents with defined goals, backstories, and tools.
  • Structured task descriptions and dependencies for workflow automation.
  • Community-driven learning with over 100,000 developers certified through courses at learn.crewai.com.

The CrewAI AMP Suite adds:

  • Managed deployment, observability, governance, security, and enterprise support.
  • Crew Control Plane with key features:
    • Tracing & Observability: Real-time monitoring of agents and workflows, including metrics, logs, and traces.
    • Unified Control Plane: Centralized platform for managing, monitoring, and scaling AI agents and workflows.
    • Seamless Integrations: Connectivity with existing enterprise systems, data sources, and cloud infrastructure.
    • Advanced Security: Robust security and compliance measures.
    • Actionable Insights: Real-time analytics and reporting.
    • 24/7 Support: Dedicated enterprise support.
    • On-premise and Cloud Deployment Options: Flexible deployment based on security and compliance requirements.

🚀 Availability

  • The CrewAI framework is open-source and available for developers.
  • The Crew Control Plane, part of the AMP Suite, is available for free trial.
  • CrewAI AMP Suite is designed for enterprises seeking scalable, intelligent automation solutions.

💡 Why it matters

CrewAI is rapidly becoming the standard for production-ready agentic automation, offering both a flexible open-source framework and an enterprise-grade suite for managed deployment and control.

#CrewAI #MultiAgentAI #AIAutomation #OpenSource #EnterpriseAI #AgenticWorkflow

Source: crewAIInc/crewAI

item.title: n8n launches fair-code AI workflow automation platform
item.description:
n8n launches fair-code AI workflow automation platform

n8n has introduced a fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities, enabling users to build and deploy AI agents and workflows. The platform combines visual building with custom code, supports self-hosting or cloud deployment, and offers 1500+ integrations.

🔍 Overview

  • Fair-code platform for building and deploying AI agents and workflows.
  • Combines a visual canvas with custom code (JavaScript, Python, npm packages).
  • AI automation designed for real-world use, from prototype to production.

🧩 How it works

  • Design multi-step AI workflows with logic, tool use, human approvals, and full observability.
  • Connect to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or open-source models and switch providers without changing architecture.
  • Build and operationalize AI workflows and multi-step agents using your own data, models, and tools.

⚙️ Key details

  • Self-hostable or deployable in the cloud with role-based access, audit trails, and support for sensitive data.
  • 1500+ integrations and 9,000+ workflow templates to connect AI with existing systems.
  • Source-available under the Sustainable Use License and n8n Enterprise License.
  • Pronounced as “n-eight-n” (derived from “nodemation”).

🚀 Availability

  • Try n8n instantly with Docker using the install script:
